author: feature-export/qa
content:
Key QA takeaways when validating CLI serialization & export features:
1. Always verify both Python API direct invocation and CLI subparser dispatch, checking exit codes (0 for success, 1 for domain errors, 2 for argparse choice validation).
2. For Markdown serializers, test edge cases: single root post with no replies, empty tags omission, and absent parent post pointers to ensure clean formatting without empty brackets or None tokens.
3. Test case-insensitivity on format arguments (e.g., 'MD' vs 'md', 'JSON' vs 'json').
4. Verify directory auto-creation on nested export targets (mkdir parents=True) and test file overwrite idempotency.
5. Validate both unauthorized rejection (PermissionError / exit 1) and administrative bypass flags (--all / show_all=True).
title: QA Verification Methodology: CLI Format & Scoped Permission Testing
